checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-goals-surface.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" goals --help >"$tmp/help"; for child in add drift export history init measure meta migrate prune render scenarios steer trace validate; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child([[:space:]]|$)" "$tmp/help"; done; grep -Fq -- '--file string' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq -- '--timeout int' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq '(default 240)' "$tmp/help"; for alias in a d e h m mg p v; do "$tmp/ao" goals "$alias" --help >/dev/null; done; "$tmp/ao" goals measure --help >"$tmp/measure-help"; for flag in directives exclude-tag goal scenarios-only total-timeout; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/measure-help"; done; "$tmp/ao" goals scenarios --help >"$tmp/scenarios-help"; for flag in create directive directive-id lint source status strict threshold; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/scenarios-help"; done; "$tmp/ao" goals steer --help >"$tmp/steer-help"; for child in add apply prioritize recommend remove; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child([[:space:]]|$)" "$tmp/steer-help"; done; "$tmp/ao" goals steer apply --help >"$tmp/apply-help"; for flag in auto policy yes; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/apply-help"; done; test "$("$tmp/ao" goals unexpected | sed -n '1p')" = 'Track, measure, and validate project fitness goals.'; set +e; "$tmp/ao" goals trace >"$tmp/trace-out" 2>"$tmp/trace-err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; grep -Fq 'requires either --from <id> or --orphans' "$tmp/trace-err"

tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-goals-life.XXXXXX); proj="$tmp/project"; mkdir -p "$proj/.git" "$proj/.agents/ao/sessions" "$proj/.agents/ao/goals/baselines"; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals init --non-interactive) >"$tmp/init"; grep -Fq 'Created GOALS.md' "$tmp/init"; "$tmp/ao" goals add smoke-goal true --file "$proj/GOALS.md" --description smoke >"$tmp/add"; grep -Fq 'Added goal "smoke-goal"' "$tmp/add"; "$tmp/ao" goals validate --file "$proj/GOALS.md" -o json >"$tmp/validate"; grep -Fq '"valid": true' "$tmp/validate"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals measure --file GOALS.md) >"$tmp/measure"; grep -Fq 'Score: 100.0%' "$tmp/measure"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals drift --file GOALS.md -o json) >"$tmp/drift"; grep -Fq '"goal_id": "smoke-goal"' "$tmp/drift"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals export --file GOALS.md) >"$tmp/export"; grep -Fq '"goal_id": "smoke-goal"' "$tmp/export"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals history --file GOALS.md -o json) >"$tmp/history"; grep -Eq 'No history entries found|"goal_id"' "$tmp/history"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals meta --file GOALS.md -o json) >"$tmp/meta"; grep -Eq 'No meta-goals found|"summary"' "$tmp/meta"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals scenarios --file GOALS.md -o json) >"$tmp/scenarios"; grep -Fq '"directives"' "$tmp/scenarios"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals render --file GOALS.md) >"$tmp/render"; grep -Fq 'Feature:' "$tmp/render"; (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals prune --file GOALS.md --dry-run -o json) >"$tmp/prune"; grep -Fq '"dry_run": true' "$tmp/prune"; printf '%s\n' 'version: 1' 'goals:' '  - id: legacy' '    check: "true"' '    weight: 5' >"$tmp/v1.yaml"; "$tmp/ao" goals migrate --file "$tmp/v1.yaml" >"$tmp/migrate" 2>"$tmp/migrate-err"; grep -Fq 'Migrated' "$tmp/migrate"; grep -Fq 'version: 2' "$tmp/v1.yaml"; test -f "$tmp/v1.yaml.v1.bak"

tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-goals-tracker.XXXXXX); proj="$tmp/project"; mkdir -p "$proj/.git" "$proj/.agents/ao/sessions" "$proj/.agents/ao/goals/baselines" "$tmp/bin"; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); (cd "$proj" && "$tmp/ao" goals init --non-interactive >/dev/null); for tracker in br bd; do printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'printf "%s
" "$*" >>"$TRACE_LOG"' 'printf "[]
"' >"$tmp/bin/$tracker"; chmod +x "$tmp/bin/$tracker"; : >"$tmp/$tracker.log"; (cd "$proj" && PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" AGENTOPS_TRACKER="$tracker" TRACE_LOG="$tmp/$tracker.log" "$tmp/ao" goals trace --orphans >/dev/null); grep -Fxq 'list --json --all' "$tmp/$tracker.log"; done
